incidental_finding.what: the corpora were generated by Lean 4.32.2, but Mathlib at the pinned 2ec0166b declares leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0-rc1, and ramanujan/container/pins.json replays capsules under 4.33.0-rc1.
incidental_finding.harmless_for: D1, D2, D3, D6, D7 — these parse Mathlib source and do not depend on the checker version
incidental_finding.not_harmless_for: D4. Its records ARE real compiler error text, captured under 4.32.2, while the container that would re-check them runs 4.33.0-rc1. Different Lean, different error strings.
incidental_finding.pins_own_words: the pin file already argues this exact point in the other direction: 'A Mathlib pin is meaningless against a Lean that Mathlib will not load.' The same reasoning applies to the corpus generator.
incidental_finding.status: OPEN. Not fixed here; recorded because it affects whether D4 is a valid training corpus, not because it affects storage.
